title: EL-Shellability of the poset of ranked cactuses
summary: Recently the poset of ranked cactuses $(\mathfrak{P}(X),\preceq)$ was introduced. For a finite set $X$, this poset consists of a set $\mathfrak{P}(X)$ of certain collections of ordered pairs of subsets of $X$ together with an ordering $\preceq$ that is similar to the refinement ordering of partitions of a finite set. In addition, the maximal chains in this poset correspond to binary ranked cactuses, a fact which can be used to construct the so-called space of equidistant cactuses.
